articles.title: Partnerships & Stakeholders: Science and Technology Community
articles.description: The role of global science, academia, research and innovation is enshrined in the Sendai Framework for Disaster Risk Reduction where it is recognized for the catalytic, boundary-pushing and transformative potential it holds for addressing the dynamic drivers of disaster risk.

articles.title: Statement on the Colombia Earthquake by Kamal Kishore, Special Representative of the UN Secretary-General for Disaster Risk Reduction and Head of UNDRR
articles.description: Statement on the Colombia Earthquake by Kamal Kishore, Special Representative of the UN Secretary-General for Disaster Risk Reduction and Head of UNDRR

articles.title: UNDRR at UNCCD COP17
articles.description: UNDRR takes part in the 17th session of the Conference of the Parties to the UN Convention to Combat Desertification, in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia, with five side events on drought risk, ecosystem loss and damage, water-related disasters and early warning.

articles.title: Strengthening Private Sector Engagement in Early Warning Systems: Caribbean Leaders Convene in Barbados
articles.description: Discussions focused on how the private sector contributes across the full early warning value chain—from risk information and data to communication, operations, and response, and what is required to move from participation to collaboration.

articles.title: Disaster Risk Reduction Elements in the PPED Draft Articles - Side Event on the Margins of the PPED PrepCom
Building Risk-Informed and Resilient SMEs in the Arab Region
articles.description: UNDRR ROAS will convene a regional workshop in Baghdad to strengthen SME resilience across the Arab States by promoting disaster risk reduction, business continuity planning, resilient supply chains and public-private partnerships.

articles.title: UNDRR July 2026 newsletter
articles.description: This month's issue covers new resources to strengthen early warning systems, growing global momentum on urban resilience, and partnerships advancing disaster risk reduction across the Americas, Africa, the Arab region and Asia-Pacific, and more inside.

articles.title: Enhancing Alexandria’s climate resilience through the Alexandria Consortium and MCR2030
articles.description: Alexandria faces a complex and interconnected risk landscape shaped by coastal hazards, climate change, rapid urban growth, infrastructure exposure and increasing pressure on essential services.

articles.title: Oman advances disaster-risk reduction and climate-action planning through national workshop
articles.description: The Sultanate of Oman gathered governmental and non-governmental representative, and technical experts at a national workshop focused on strengthening disaster risk reduction (DRR).
